name: atlanai-analytics
description: Build the context your coding agent answers data questions from, on a sample or your own data: metrics and saved queries from your dashboards and past queries, tested on your data, kept on this machine or saved to Atlan.

interface.shortDescription: Build the context your agent answers data questions from
interface.longDescription: Seven skills that build and test the context your coding agent answers data questions from: metrics and saved queries. analytics-demo builds it for one of two fictional companies on made-up data. analytics-build builds it on your own data, starting from nothing, a dashboard or a subject: dashboards first, then past queries, then table definitions. source-survey says what a source holds and what can be built from it. metrics-generation builds, tests, edits and saves metrics and saved queries. analytics-ask answers a data question from them, names what each answer is based on, and turns answers into a dashboard. eval-generation turns the questions a team already asks into test questions with known answers. accuracy-check tests the context on those questions and says why each miss failed.
defaultPrompt: Show me an Atlan Analytics demo
Help me use this dashboard, folder or BI export to ask questions about my data
Build metrics and saved queries for our support tables from the warehouse's past queries
